The company added $1.5 billion to its buyback program last month and is gearing up for third-quarter financial results next month. Spotify has beat analyst estimates for earnings per share in three of the last four quarters, while missing revenue in two straight quarters. The next quarter could show if the company is gaining subscribers with recent price increases.

: The company known for moving vehicles and storage saw strong interest from readers with shares at three-month lows. The company held a virtual analyst and investor meeting last month that may see more analyst price target changes in the coming weeks. In recent quarterly financial results, the company has been missing earnings per share estimates from analysts, while beating revenue targets. The company is sometimes a gauge for how often people are moving and to what parts of the country. With high mortgage rates, the company could be under pressure.
